scenarios.title: Scenario 1 — Normal Baseline
scenarios.description: Clear operating conditions across all mountain corridors. Essential medicine delivery V-101 is on schedule via Primary Lifeline Corridor A.

scenarios.title: Scenario 2 — Heavy Rainfall Surge
scenarios.description: Localized monsoon storm (65 mm/h) over S-08 Pass & Tunnel Section. Risk engine escalates risk score from 22 to 78 (HIGH). Caution alert dispatched.

alert.title: Landslide Risk Increased
alert.message: Corridor A / Segment S-08 has reached HIGH RISK due to heavy rainfall (65 mm/h). Expected delay: +2h 14m. Recommended action: Monitor corridor and standby for reroute.

scenarios.title: Scenario 3 — Landslide & Road Closure
scenarios.description: Massive slope failure near S-08 Tunnel Approach. Both lanes blocked. Route engine detects blockage, evaluates graph, and recommends Alternate Corridor B.

metrics.recommendation_reason: Avoids high-risk blocked corridor on Segment S-08.

alert.title: ROUTE UPDATED — Road Closure Detected Ahead
alert.message: Physical blockage confirmed on Segment S-08. Primary route impassable. Recommended Route: Alternative Corridor B (ETA: 6h 03m, Distance: 206 km).

scenarios.title: Scenario 4 — Corridor Clearance & Recovery
scenarios.description: PWD clearance crews restore single-lane emergency traffic. S-08 returns to RESTRICTED then OPEN as weather eases.
